content.text: No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee provisions appear anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee, or early-termination-fee obligation payable by AP, meeting the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", and "termination fee" return nothing, and a full read of the single section confirms it. The only money-on-termination language (para 4(a)) simply confirms Kubient keeps revenue-share fees actually generated during the 90-day notice period — that is earned compensation under the revenue-share in Section 5, not a liquidated sum or exit penalty, and it does not apply where AP terminates for Kubient's material breach. Termination consequences in 4(c) are limited to ceasing Services, revoking the license, and returning Confidential Information, with no payment trigger. Note also that Section 7 excludes punitive and special damages for both Parties, further reducing any penalty exposure. No redline is warranted.
